title: New Update Available (v1.0.4+22)
message: Auto-request Notification & Unrestricted Background Running Permissions for Instant Alerts.
releaseNotes:
• Automatically requests Notification & Background Battery permissions at install/startup
• Dedicated prompt to enable alerts if denied
• Multi-topic global broadcast to all app devices
• Instant background push alerts even when phone screen is locked or app is swiped away
